service.description: "Drop-ship from supplier": a customer order line moved to the supplier's drop-ship facility (its part, or a new part of the order at that facility with the part's customer, ship-to and shipping), reserved there, and on an approved order bought at once (create#DropShipPurchaseOrder). Requires PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT in the selling organization (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE); refuses a supplier the organization may not buy from (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE) or the buying policy stops, one with no current canDropShip price of the product (NOT_DROP_SHIPPABLE) or no drop-ship facility (NO_DROP_SHIP_FACILITY), a line already shipped (LINE_SHIPPED) or on a drop-ship order (ALREADY_DROP_SHIPPED), and an order no longer open (ORDER_STATE).

parameter.name: facilityId
parameter.description: The supplier's drop-ship facility; its first when empty

service.description: An order's approval once it commits (DropShip.secas.xml OrderApprovedDropShip, tx-commit): a drop-ship purchase order is sent (send#DropShipPurchaseOrder); an approved sales order's lines reserved at a drop-ship facility get their purchase orders (create#DropShipPurchaseOrder, in a transaction of its own). A failure is logged naming the order and its lines, and the approval stands. Any other order returns after one count of the drop-ship facilities. No permission check: the approval's commit runs it.

An approved drop-ship purchase order sent to its supplier once the approval commits (handle#OrderApprovedDropShip): through the drop-ship facility's remote (its send#DropShipPurchaseOrderPart implementation), then Sent, else by email on send#PurchaseOrder's path. Any other order returns at once; a failed send is logged and the order stays approved for the buyer to send. No permission check: it runs as the approver.

An order's drop-ship state for a purchasing user (PURCHASE_ORDER_EDIT, PURCHASE_APPROVE or PURCHASE_ORDER_APPROVE) of its organization. kind sales: each product line's state (ships from the warehouse, drops when approved, on its drop-ship purchase order, delivered), that order, and for a buyer the suppliers it may drop from. kind purchase: the customer and ship-to, the parent sales order, each line's delivered and remaining quantity, and whether the supplier's confirmation is pending. kind null for any other order or user.

A supplier's drop-ship facility, new or its name and remote changed: type FcTpDropShip, owned by the supplier, assetAllowOtherOwner Y, its remote (SystemMessageRemote) the integration that receives its orders, empty to email them. Requires PURCHASE_POLICY_EDIT in the organization (PERMISSION_DENIED, RECORD_UNAVAILABLE) and a supplier it may buy from (SUPPLIER_UNAVAILABLE); refuses an unknown remote (REMOTE_INVALID) and another facility (FACILITY_INVALID).
A supplier's drop-ship facilities with their remotes, the remotes to choose from and whether the user may change them (PURCHASE_POLICY_EDIT), for a purchasing user (PERMISSION_DENIED).
